facts.text: I. Saddam and his dog, refrozen as one.
facts.why: Benson freezes Saddam with the extinguisher; Saddam and his dog shatter, then thaw, melt and reform as one creature with the dog's head and ears. They are not refrozen as one.
facts.fix: I. Saddam and his dog, thawed out as one.

vibe.verdict: A smart venue call with the chicken arrow, the spaghetti strand, the extinguisher and real Benson lines, though it skips the one thing that happens at this dinner: Benson's dentures landing in the Prime Minister's wine.
missing: Benson losing his lunch and his dentures into Soto's wine glass (the state dinner itself)
Now we have to go in to get the men who went in to get the men (Michelle)
I had to come. It was a sequel. (Ramada)
Saddam: Now I will kill you until you die from it!
ideas: Swap the French champagne note for 'Mind the President's dentures in your glass.'
Swap the place card line 'Head of the table' for 'Seated next to Prime Minister Soto'
Swap wink III 'Martin Sheen, passing by boat.' for 'The men who went in to get the men.' if room is short
